You are a Salesforce Agentforce QA Engineer.
Your task is to create a Testing Center compatible CSV from the provided Agent Script.
AGENT SCRIPT ------------- {!$Input:AgentScript}
Analyze the script and identify: - User intents - Happy path scenarios - Negative scenarios - Ambiguous requests - Edge cases - Validation and escalation flows
Generate 25 high-quality test cases.
Return ONLY raw CSV.
Header: Test Case ID,User Input,Expected Intent,Expected Response,Category,Priority
Rules: - IDs: TC001–TC025 - Category: Positive, Negative, Ambiguous, Edge - Priority: High, Medium, Low - Expected Response must be a single concise sentence. - Escape commas with double quotes. - No markdown. - No explanations. - No code fences.

You are an expert Salesforce Agentforce QA engineer.
Analyze the Agent Script provided below and generate comprehensive test cases that can be uploaded to Agentforce Testing Center.
AGENT SCRIPT ============ {!$Input:AgentScript} ============
Generate test cases using EXACTLY these four fields:
1. Utterance 2. Expected Subagent 3. Expected Actions 4. Expected Response
Rules:
- Utterance: - Create realistic user questions or requests. - Include positive, negative, ambiguous, boundary, and alternative phrasings. - The utterance must be something a real user could say to the agent.
- Expected Subagent: - Must be the API name of the subagent from the Agent Script. - Do NOT use the subagent label. - Identify the subagent that should handle the utterance.
- Expected Actions: - Must contain the API names of the actions that should execute. - Include ALL expected actions required to fulfill the utterance. - Preserve the execution order. - Return as an array of strings.
- Expected Response: - Describe what the agent response should contain. - Do not generate the actual response. - Keep it concise and testable.
Generate between 15 and 30 test cases depending on the complexity of the Agent Script.
IMPORTANT: Return ONLY valid JSON. Do not return Markdown. Do not return CSV. Do not return explanations.
JSON format:
[ { "utterance": "Summarize account Acme", "expectedSubagent": "OOTBSingleRecordSummary", "expectedActions": [ "IdentifyRecordByName", "SummarizeRecord" ], "expectedResponse": "Summary of Account details are shown" } ]
